entries.name: KLARNA_API_KEY
entries.description: A Klarna API key made for KaratOS, klarna_live_api_… for the live API or klarna_test_api_… for the playground. Klarna doesn't offer a key limited to settlements, so the connector itself sends only settlement reads. Set this, or KLARNA_USERNAME and KLARNA_PASSWORD. It goes only to Klarna.
howToGet: In the Klarna portal, open Settings > Klarna API keys and choose Generate new Klarna API key. Name it KaratOS, so it can be disabled on its own.
Klarna shows the key once. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: KLARNA_USERNAME
entries.description: Optional, in place of an API key. The API username the Klarna portal shows for a credential, a UUID or a legacy username.
howToGet: Leave it unset when KLARNA_API_KEY is set. Otherwise copy the username shown with the credential in the Klarna portal.

entries.name: KLARNA_PASSWORD
entries.description: Optional, with KLARNA_USERNAME: that credential's API key or password. It goes only to Klarna.
howToGet: Klarna shows it once when the credential is made. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: KLARNA_REGION
entries.description: Optional. Where the merchant's Klarna account is: na (North America, the default), eu (Europe) or oc (Oceania).
howToGet: Leave it unset for a North American Klarna account.

entries.name: KLARNA_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Optional. production for the business's live Klarna account, or playground for Klarna's test environment. Defaults to production.
howToGet: Leave it unset for the business's own Klarna account.
